Game Overview

Easter Deer is a platformer game built around navigate a reindeer through an endless sky filled with obstacles in this Easter adventure. Collect colorful Easter eggs and dodge dangers while ensuring a safe descent to the finish line. Stay airborne and enjoy the thrill of keeping the reindeer aloft on this festive journey.
